 Companies on Fonzi are Applied AI startups, Frontier labs, Hypergrowth startups, PE firms starting lean AI teams and more. They're backed by investors like A16z, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Y Combinator and more.
 



  





 How It Works
 



  




* 5\-minute application
* We reach out, learn what you're building and what excites you, and optimize your profile
* Hiring managers review the cohort and request interviews with candidates they want
* Companies submit competing salary bids directly to you
* You only interview where you're genuinely interested
* Completely free. We have an iMessage agent \+ humans in the loop you can text anytime w/ questions or requests to help handle scheduling and coordination



 Who We're Looking For
 



  





**The research engineers who do best on Fonzi:** 




  




* Have turned research ideas into working code: training runs, experiments and evals
* Are strong in Python and PyTorch, and comfortable with distributed training and GPUs
* Have worked on LLM training, fine\-tuning, reinforcement learning or evaluation
* Can read a paper, implement it and tell whether it actually works
* Thrive in small teams where research and engineering sit side by side
* Have 2\-8 years of experience in research engineering, ML or a related field



 What You'll Build
 



  





**The companies on Fonzi are working on:** 




  




* Post\-training, RL and fine\-tuning pipelines for frontier and domain\-specific models
* Evaluation systems that measure what models can actually do

* Agents, world models and new architectures moving from paper to product

 Compensation
 



  




* $170,000 to $250,000\+ base salary depending on experience and role. Many positions include meaningful equity at pre\-seed through Series B stage companies.



 The Interview Process (Typical)
 



  




* Screening conversation looking for communication skills, cultural fit and research curiosity
* Technical deep\-dive on a past project, your experimental choices and what you learned
* Coding or pairing session on ML implementation or experiment design



 If you want your research to ship, not sit in a paper, we want to hear from you.
